rundown: Alejandro Tabilo beat Alex Michelsen in sets: 7-5, 7-6.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 12, 6:56 AM ET. It had Alex Michelsen 64% and Alejandro Tabilo 36%.

Final: Alex Michelsen 0 – Alejandro Tabilo 2. Wrong winner: it had Alex Michelsen at 64%, and Alejandro Tabilo (36%) won.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: Alex Michelsen to win: the algo gave it 64%, THE PICK — lost.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body: Flagged going in: there were no odds to check the projection against.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body: The result goes into both players' Elo ratings at the next data run, so their next match is priced on it.
